# Scan 8 pointing review (prayer blocks 1, 3, 5): changes required

I'm not approving the candidate. One added mark contradicts a mark you already settled, and most of the 127 added marks can't be confirmed at the resolution of the images I have.

- **Wrong added mark:** in block 3, word 102 (`הַשָּׁמַ֖֙יִם֙`, in "כימי השמים על־הארץ"), the candidate adds a tipcha under the מ. You had already settled a pashta on both the מ and the ם there. A word can't carry both a tipcha and a pashta, so the tipcha should come out. The provenance file says `conflicts: []`, so its conflict check missed this.
- **Placement checks out:** I counted all 127 added marks by hand. Each one sits on the letter the provenance file names.
- **Not confirmable:** about 85 of the added marks sit below the letters. At this resolution I can't tell those glyphs apart (munach, merkha, tipcha, darga, tevir, etnachta, mahpakh and meteg). About 14 marks drawn as dots above the line are visible, but I can't tell a single dot (revia) from a double dot (zaqef qatan). None of these should be approved just to complete the set. They need tighter crops.
- **Visible above the line:** I could see marks matching 17 of the added marks: pashta, gershayim, qadma, and the revia dot on מְהֵרָ֗ה (list in the JSON). This only covers those marks, not whole words.
- **Holam in מצות:** the image shows one dot over the vav in both occurrences. It can't tell U+05B9 from U+05BA, so the choice doesn't affect how faithfully the printed mark is reproduced. Which form to use is an encoding question, outside this review.
- **Records not found:** I couldn't locate the question 870–877 records; I checked five likely paths and none existed. The `s8_image_adjudications.json` I did find mentions only questions 870–875. Settled marks from it were left alone.
